name: Gemini Embedding
description: Versatile embedding model for text search and retrieval.
longDescription: Gemini Embedding generates state-of-the-art embeddings for semantic search, classification, and clustering. It supports flexible output dimensions and multiple task types including retrieval, similarity, and classification.

codeSnippets.label: Python
codeSnippets.code:
from google import genai

client = genai.Client()
response = client.models.embed_content(
    model="gemini-embedding",
    contents="Hello world"
)
print(response.embeddings[0].values[:5])
